rows.summary: **Now:** Design → Links prints every link Plain, Underlined (in the contact's own colour, keeping a strike-through) or in the accent — contacts, entry URLs, summary, descriptions and the cover letter. Design → Section Headings → Icons prints a small icon before every section title on every template, in the title's colour and size. Languages → Level offers Text, Dots or Bar ("Non-native" is no level). Experience → Group roles by company prints consecutive roles at one company under one employer header. Personal Info → Photo offers Position (Left, Right — the cover letter follows it) and Tone (Color, Grayscale).
rows.remaining: Column layout (details top/left/right, one/two/mixed columns, adjustable widths — PENDING-ALL.md:83, R2-147-col); a per-skill level (side-column bars are a fixed 80%). Levels map Professional = Intermediate = 3; no editor word gives 2 (a design call).
